note: Which wide multiplexers gowin-gw1n1-widemux.fs really uses, read back by Project Apicula’s own unpacker - a separate implementation from ours.
reading: selectRouted lists, per tile, the wide multiplexers whose SELECT the bitstream routes to a real signal - gowin_unpack writes an unrouted select as `= VCC`, which is the fabric power-up state. ofRead lists every tile wire that takes its signal FROM a multiplexer output OF<n>.
